confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and Rome-based calibration, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are the most reliable; hostel and hotel anchors carry the widest uncertainty because July demand in Florence is seasonal and volatile. Cocktail and wine anchors are partly set relative to the beer anchor because direct local knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from a web search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a downloaded table. No web-sourced city prices were used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored mainly to Rome, a comparable Italian city with similar restaurant and cafe pricing. Beer, coffee and meal anchors sit close to Rome levels, while hostel and hotel anchors are set roughly 10 to 25 percent above Rome to reflect Florence's July accommodation premium. Amsterdam and Bucharest were used only to bound the overall range.
